# 講經筆記

> 體佛法師於賢首禪苑歷年講經的學習筆記與完整逐字稿。

- [體佛法師講經筆記](https://tiedy.com/dharma-notes/)：各講經系列、名相・人物・地名索引與引用經論
- [完整網站地圖（llms.txt）](https://tiedy.com/dharma-notes/llms.txt)
- [Dharma Translations](https://tiedy.com/dharma-translations/): provisional English of Chinese Buddhist texts, line by line, every line's reasons shown
